cohort: 3978 twin deliveries at less than 37 weeks gestation from a national database between 2003-2012
finding: Mode of delivery and birth order have a gestational age dependent effect on the incidence of RDS, with cesarean delivery significantly increasing the frequency of RDS in both twins compared with vaginal birth, but only at gestational ages <30 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery significantly increased the frequency of RDS in both twins compared with vaginal birth, but only at gestational ages <30 weeks.
